answer: Each identity must open a vault of 100 staked units with its own anchor in a distinct recent block hash, and the k-th vault from one funder stays locked for k epochs, so N fakes tie up 100N(N+1)/2 epoch-units of stake-time: 5,500 for 10, 505,000 for 100. A walnut receipt seals each vault, and one receipt presented for two identities voids both vaults at the close.
